The following actions will give a chance to drop this pet:
• fletching or stringing bows
• fletching headless arrows
• feathering or tipping ammunition like
• Arrows 
• Bolts
• Darts
• fletching logs at the Fletcher's hut in the Dream of Iaia
• Zygomite carestyling
• fletching totems during the Fenmoor Totems activity
The following actions will not give a chance to drop this pet:
• Using protean logs or unstable protean logs
• Playing a Minigame that rewards experience in this skill

Gaining this item is based on the amount of experience awarded at once; the more experience granted per item made, the greater the chance of gaining this pet. The chance is not affected by experience boosters.
In a purely mathematical format, the chance f of receiving the pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{(B / 20) \times S}{50,000,000}
Where:
• B is the base experience per action
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 200 is applied to this value

tx:
10 Zemomarks are received upon first entry to New Varrock. More zemomarks may be earned by:
• Completing Dimension of Disaster subquests
• Completing the sets in the New Varrock achievements
• Selling items obtained in New Varrock to stores
• Opening chests around New Varrock and stealing loot (requires a lockpick, obtained during the subquest Dimension of Disaster: Shield of Arrav)
• Attacking or pickpocketing citizens of New Varrock
As players cannot use the banks in the city, as the skeleton clerk tells them that they "no longer serve the fleshy folk", nor is there a Grand Exchange. Thus, it is recommended to sell supplies they will not need or are easily replaced.
▸ Strategy
There are multiple methods to gain more Zemomarks, whether players need them for quest outfits, elemental staves, or the mystery gift which costs 200,000 zemomarks and contains the chromatic partyhat required for the achievement Seven Colours in Their Hat. The player can utilise shop supplies to profit from crafting items. Due to limited supplies, it's recommended to use multiple of the following techniques while waiting for each to replenish:
• Fastest method: Kill zombies with a staff of air bought from Zaff's Superior Spellcasting for 1,500 zemomarks using air spells just northwest of Zaff's shop. Place Magma Tempest, Chain, Dragon Breath, Corruption Blast, and Tsunami at the front of the Revolution bar. Only pick up stackable items like ammo and runes, as well as staves of water, earth, and fire (staff of air only sells for 20 zemomarks) The easiest way to do this is to set a keybind for 'Target cycle forward' and use it when the player kills a target and use area loot to pick up the loot. If using Magma Tempest, they can receive around 50,000 zemomarks per hour from rune drops alone.…
